strategies.name: Medallion-Style Short-Horizon Statistical Prediction (Public Characterization)
strategies.market: Primarily liquid US and international equities/futures (exact book UNKNOWN)

signal.text: Public sources describe ensembles of short-horizon predictive signals from price/volume and other features; exact features UNKNOWN.

entry.text: Model-predicted positive expected return after costs; thresholds UNKNOWN.

exit.text: Short holding periods; continuous re-forecasting; exact exit rules UNKNOWN.

position_sizing.text: Highly constrained optimization with risk limits; Kelly-like speculation is SPECULATIVE.

risk_management.text: Strict risk overlays and diversification across many weak signals (public interviews/books).

hedging.text: Market-neutral / hedged characterization common in public literature.

execution.text: Low-latency execution important; proprietary stack UNKNOWN.

automation.text: Fully systematic / automated per public accounts.

data_requirements.text: High-quality historical market data; alternative data role UNKNOWN.

annualized_return.note: Net returns widely reported in secondary sources but not confirmed here from primary filings

sharpe.note: Extraordinary Sharpe claims circulate; treat as unverified unless primary source attached

signal.text: Rank assets by past 3–12 month returns excluding recent month; long winners / short losers.

entry.text: Rebalance on schedule into top/bottom momentum quantiles.

exit.text: Exit when rank falls out of selected quantile at next rebalance.

position_sizing.text: Equal-weight or risk-parity within sleeves; volatility scaling common.

risk_management.text: Sector/country neutralization; volatility targeting; drawdown controls.

hedging.text: Often run long-short market-neutral or long-only factor tilts.

execution.text: Periodic rebalance with transaction-cost optimization.

automation.text: Fully systematizable; widely automated in industry.

data_requirements.text: Total return price histories, corporate actions, investability filters.

sharpe.note: Long-run factor Sharpe often cited ~0.3–0.6 before costs; varies by sample

years_operating.note: Academic factor since Jegadeesh/Titman 1993; industry longer

crisis_performance.value: Poor in sharp momentum crash regimes

strategies.name: Time-Series Trend Following (CTA)
strategies.market: Futures across equities, rates, FX, commodities

signal.text: Price above/below moving averages or positive time-series momentum; multi-horizon blends common.

entry.text: Enter long/short when trend signal exceeds threshold.

exit.text: Exit or reverse on signal flip; trailing stops sometimes used.

position_sizing.text: Volatility targeting / risk parity across markets is standard public practice.

risk_management.text: Vol scaling, correlation-aware allocation, max leverage caps.

hedging.text: Diversification across uncorrelated futures; not classic beta hedge.

execution.text: Mostly daily/weekly; some intraday overlays.

data_requirements.text: Futures prices, rolls, volatility estimates.

sharpe.note: Long-run CTA trend Sharpe often cited ~0.4–0.7; path dependent

crisis_performance.value: Historically often positive in equity crises (crisis alpha narrative)

signal.text: Microprice, queue position, inventory, short-term order-flow imbalance; exact models proprietary.

entry.text: Post bid/ask; selectively take when edge vs adverse selection.

exit.text: Inventory mean-reversion; skew quotes; hard flatten limits.

position_sizing.text: Inventory caps; risk units by symbol volatility and ADV.

risk_management.text: Kill switches, fat-finger limits, venue risk, toxicity filters.

execution.text: Co-located matching-engine access; smart order routing.

data_requirements.text: Full depth/L3, proprietary normalized market data.

annualized_return.note: Public firms disclose trading income not strategy Sharpe

signal.text: Cointegration / residual z-score vs peer basket or factor model; trade dislocations.

entry.text: Enter when residual z-score exceeds entry threshold.

exit.text: Exit at mean reversion / time stop / stop-loss on residual.

position_sizing.text: Dollar or beta neutrality; volatility-scaled legs.

risk_management.text: Factor neutrality, hard loss limits, borrow constraints.

hedging.text: Long-short residual portfolios; market beta hedged.

execution.text: VWAP/TWAP/implementation shortfall algos.

data_requirements.text: Point-in-time fundamentals/prices, borrow, corporate actions.

sharpe.note: Academic pairs papers show attractive pre-cost Sharpes; live net UNKNOWN

signal.text: Cheap vs expensive on value metrics (B/M, E/P, CF/P composites).

entry.text: Periodic rebalance into value quantile / score-weighted book.

exit.text: Exit when valuation scores normalize relative to universe.

position_sizing.text: Score or equal weight; industry neutralization common.

risk_management.text: Tracking error budgets for long-only; leverage limits for L/S.

execution.text: Low turnover relative to HFT; patient rebalance.

data_requirements.text: Point-in-time fundamentals; careful delisting treatment.

sharpe.note: Long-run value premium debated; recent decade weak in US

crisis_performance.value: Cyclical; value underperformed growth for long stretches post-2010s

signal.text: Deal spread vs estimated completion probability and timing.

entry.text: Long target / short acquirer (stock deals) when spread compensates for break risk.

exit.text: Deal close, deal break, or spread compression to target.

position_sizing.text: Conviction × capital at risk; hard caps per deal.

risk_management.text: Deal-break scenarios, regulatory risk, financing risk, portfolio deal correlation.

hedging.text: Cash deals: long target; stock deals: hedge acquirer.

execution.text: Cash equity with borrow management.

automation.text: Semi-systematic overlays; human deal assessment still central at most funds.

data_requirements.text: Deal terms databases, regulatory calendars, option-implied break odds.

sharpe.note: Classic merger arb Sharpe often cited moderate with low vol

signal.text: Cheap convert vs model fair value / implied vol vs hedge instruments.

entry.text: Long cheap convert, short delta hedge equity (and sometimes credit hedge).

exit.text: Richening to fair value, vol realization, or forced deleveraging.

position_sizing.text: Leverage common historically; risk in gamma/credit/liquidity.

risk_management.text: Liquidity risk critical (2005/2008 lessons); haircuts, funding.

hedging.text: Dynamic delta; credit and interest-rate hedges.

execution.text: OTC convert markets + exchange equity hedges.

automation.text: Pricing engines automated; risk overlays semi-automated.

data_requirements.text: Convert terms, borrow, credit spreads, option surfaces.

crisis_performance.value: Severe stress in 2008 due to leverage and liquidity

signal.text: Long high-yielding currencies / short low-yielding; interest rate differential.

entry.text: Rank currencies by carry; form long-short basket.

exit.text: Rebalance on carry ranks; crash risk overlays sometimes added.

position_sizing.text: Vol targeting; crash-risk aware sizing recommended in literature.

risk_management.text: Carry crashes in risk-off; use trend/vol filters in research variants.

execution.text: Spot/forwards/futures; low frequency.

data_requirements.text: Interest rates, spot FX, rolls.

strategies.name: Volatility Risk Premium / Short Volatility (Public Forms)

signal.text: Implied vol rich vs expected realized; harvest premium via option structures.

entry.text: Sell options / variance when premium estimated positive after hedge costs.

exit.text: Expiry, buyback on rich-to-cheap flip, or risk limits.

position_sizing.text: Strict loss budgets; tail risk dominates.

risk_management.text: Crash convexity; hedging with wings/variance; kill switches.

execution.text: Listed options; careful roll of short vol ETPs if used (retail forms fragile).

data_requirements.text: Option surfaces, realized vol estimators.

crisis_performance.value: Can suffer catastrophic losses (e.g., XIV Feb 2018 style events)
